quest.title: A Very Volatile Treasure
quest.description: Klee's highly explosive "treasure" proved to be a remarkably swift solution to the Abyss Mage problem. However, she fled the scene after the explosion. Confused, you decide to return to the Knights headquarters and report the matter to Jean...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Primogem x60, Mora x18000, Teachings of Freedom x5, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Go back to the Knights' headquarters and report to Jean

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Klee? You're here too?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I... *sobbing* I turned myself in.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: *sobbing* I... M—My bomb... I—I hurt someone...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: *sobbing* I broke the rules... I'll never see the light of day again...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Klee, I need you to answer me. You said someone was injured. Where are they?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait! There's been a misunderstanding.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Why is that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The person that Klee blew up was an Abyss Mage.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: But... But Mr. Fluffball was only a thief... He didn't deserve to blow up...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, come on now... Paimon already told you that the Abyss Mages are the bad guys...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And actually, they're the worst kind of bad guys you can imagine. They don't just hate the good guys, they hate all people... Their enemy is... humanity itself.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Mr. Fluffball... was a bad guy on purpose? ...Mr. Fluffball is the enemy of humanity!?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Wha... what!? I don't get it!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: This was an oversight on my part.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I did not tell you these things before because you are still young.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: In fact, the Abyss Order is a hostile force in Mondstadt which has been unusually active lately.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Because of Mondstadt's most powerful treasure?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aha, that's it! Paimon understands now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They were tracking down poor Klee because they'd heard rumors about her treasure!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just like the way Paimon's first reaction was to try and get her hands on... ahh, no— to try and get the facts on the treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: So... does that mean...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: In light of your contribution on this matter, I will allow you to take part in the next Ludi Harpastum.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Ludi Harpastum! Whoa!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #{M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight, you've gotta come too!

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Klee, where did you hide the treasure to begin with?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Were you trying to blow up the fish in Starfell Lake again?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I wasn't! I swear I wasn't!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (She's giving us that look that means, play along...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon bets Klee must get bored in there all by herself...

talks.objective: Find the door of the confinement room in Knight's headquarters.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess whooo~?
That's Paimon's voice I hear!

choices.text: Need help busting out of this joint?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Ooh, ooh, yes, please! Wait — no, I... I can't. Klee needs to be a good girl and think about what she did... Stop tempting me!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Anyway, while I'm grounded, I'm making an extra-special new treasure... the Ludi Harpastum version!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Tee-hee... I made it into the shape of a harpastum and everything! It looks so cute...

choices.text: You disguised a bomb as a harpastum!?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Just wait for Ludi Harpastum, oh yeah... They're gonna love it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeesh, if Jean was listening to this...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Klee might find herself grounded for an awful lot longer.

choices.text: Need a bite to eat or anything?
